content: Endilla gori asman edde zobin ar hinor butore hár kissu tiyar gora šeš oiye.
Ar Allaye hãt dinor din hibaye gorat aššilde hamore šeš goijje; he hãt dinor din hibar hár hamottu ziraiye.
Toi ei hãt dinor dinware Allaye duwa goriyore fobitro din goijje, kiyollahoile he dinot hibar sirišti edde goijjilde hár hamottu ziraiye.
Adom edde Hawa
In oiyede asman edde zobinor sirišṭi kahani zẽtte hinore sirišṭi gora oil, zẽtte Mabud Allaye asman edde zobin banaiye.
Hẽtte duniyair zobinot hono zõl, gas gusola nu aššil, ar maṛot hono lota-fata no fuṛe, kiyollahoile Mabud Allaye hẽtte o duniyait hono zór no defeṛa edde zobinot saš goribolla o hono manuš nu aššil.
Kintu meṛir tolottu fani uṛiyore zobinor uworor muk agagura bizito.
Toi Mabud Allaye meṛir dúil loi manuššuwar forma banaiye edde hibar nak sai fu diyore butore zibon niyaš golai diye edde manušwa ek ziyãta zandar oiye.
Ar Mabud Allaye fuke Edenot ekkan bagan lagaiye; edde hibar tiyari manušware hibaye heṛe raikke.
Mabud Allaye meṛittu hár zator gas okkol fuṛi uṛabaiye, zin saite o šundor, edde háite o bala, ar baganor maze zibon gas edde neki bodi aholor gas.
Ar baganot fani dibolla Edenottu ekkan hal niyolle; edde hiyanottu sairgan muk oiye.
Foilaganor nam oilde Fišon; iyan oilde hiyan ziyan fura Havilah deš guriyore giye, heṛe zeṛe šuna fa za.
(Ar he dešor šuna bala, ar heṛe bedullium edde šoham fattor o ase.)
Dusora halor nam oilde Gihon; iyan oilde hiyan ziyan fura Kuš deš guriyore giye.
Tisera halor nam oilde Hiddekol; iyan oilde hiyan ziyan Asšur dešor fukottu di giye. Ar sair lombor hal oilde Efurat.
Bade Mabud Allaye manušware loi Eden baganot saš goribolla edde hiyanor dehafuna goribolla heṛe raikke.
Toi Mabud Allaye manušware endilla hokum diye, "Tui ei baganor hár gasor gula issa mozin hái faribi;
kintu neki bodi ahol gasottu no há foribo, kiyollahoile ze din tui hibattu háibi, he din tui moribi moribi."
Bade Mabud Allaye hodde, "Manušwalla ekela takonan iyan bala no, ãi hitalla hitar laikka ekzon modot goroya zuri banaiyum."

Toi Mabud Allaye meṛittu hár fahari zanuwar edde asmanor faik okkolore tiyar goijje; bade manušwaye hinore ki ki name ḍake, hiyan saibolla hin okkolore hibar hãse ainne, henot manušwaye ze zandar zanuwarore ze name ḍaikke, hibar he nam oiye.
Manušwaye hár górot falede zanuwar edde asmanor hár faik okkol edde fahari zanuwar okkolor nam raikke. Kintu he manušwalla hibar laikka ekzon modot goroya zuri fa no za.
Toi Mabud Allaye manušwar uwore bári gum forefan goijje; toi hiba gumot maze Allaye hibar šaiṭṭanar ãḍḍittu ekkan loiye edde hiyanot bodole gusto loi borai diye.
Mabud Allaye manušwattu kuli loilde aḍḍigan loi ek mayafuwa goijje, edde hibare manušwar hãse ainne.
Hetunot manušwaye hodde,

content.text: kiyollahoile ibare manušwar butottu lowa oiye."

content: Hetolla manuše hitar bab mare erizagoi edde hitar bou loi ek o, ar hitara duizon ek ga o.
Hẽtte manušwa edde hibar bou hitara dunizon lenḍa aššil, ar hiyanot hitarattu hono šorom nu aššil.
